# Ru App Store

> Ru App Store (ruappstore.com) is a Russian-language app store for iPhone and iPad. It installs apps that are missing from the Russian App Store (banks, marketplaces, social networks, streaming services) directly on the iPhone, without a computer or jailbreak. Each install is signed for the user's own device. Access is a one-time purchase per iPhone, with no auto-renewal.

Operator: Железнов Максим Алексеевич, ИНН 131656459264. Ru App Store is not affiliated with the developers of the apps in its catalog. Site language: Russian.

## Main pages

- [Главная](https://ruappstore.com/): what the service does and how it works
- [Каталог приложений](https://ruappstore.com/apps): every app available for install, with version and iOS requirements
- [Купить доступ](https://ruappstore.com/buy.html): plans and prices (1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months; from 590 ₽ for one month to 2 360 ₽ for a year)
- [Регистрация iPhone](https://ruappstore.com/activate.html): registering the device in Safari
- [Установка и восстановление](https://ruappstore.com/install.html): installing Ru App Store and restoring access
- [Поддержка и контакты](https://ruappstore.com/support.html)
